messages:
Aisha: Quick sync — we need to run a 30m merge workshop to reconcile Q3 prewarm + a customer private-pilot ask. Major cross-team gaps on routing, HSM access, and prewarm capacity. Can we do 3pm PT today? :calendar:
Tom: 3pm works. Can you paste the list of must-haves vs can-waits? I want to flag runtime KV cache changes as a potential blocker.
Riley: KV cache changes + seq-length retention will need a kernel tweak. ETA ~2 dev-days to validate canary. Might block low-latency SLA for 100ms paths.
Priya: Capacity wise, Dedicated pools can support the pilot if we reserve 2 nodes. Need billing OK by EOD. Also need to confirm whether burst is via Dedicated or Hosted.
Marco: Security: any HSM/KMS integration for customer keys requires review. If customer insists on BYOK + HSM, that'll add a 2-week approval and additional infra automation.
Sam: I can reallocate one SRE for the week of the pilot to help with prewarm automation. But we should deprioritize non-essential telemetry to save infra time.
Evan: UX side — if we defer structured outputs v2, we can ship simpler tool-calls for the pilot. That reduces model changes.
Aisha: OK actionable: (1) Tom/Riley validate KV cache canary and timeline (2) Priya to confirm node reservation + billing path (3) Marco to start HSM review & list required docs (4) Sam to assign SRE (5) Evan to scope UX cut. I'll run the merge workshop at 3pm PT. Add deps to #stitchboard and link the runbook.
Tom: pinging @Riley with the cache diff now. Also adding a canary rollout snippet:
```
canary: 10%
metrics: p50_latency < 120ms
fallback: smaller-quant-model
```
Riley: got it, will test on canary and post results by 1:30pm PT.
Priya: Reserved 2 nodes in Dedicated test pool. Billing route is sales-approved. :white_check_mark:
Marco: Started HSM docs checklist, tagging compliance. Might need customer attestation.
Aisha: Sweet — thanks everyone. I'll share the calendar invite + agenda. Please bring exact TOIL estimates. :thumbsup:
